aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Ambā, Mother Brahmacāriṇī; victory to you, beloved of four-faced Brahmā, giver of happiness. You delight the heart of Brahmā, and you teach knowledge to all. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Your japa is the mantra of Brahman, which the simple-hearted world chants. Victory to you, Gāyatrī, mother of the Vedas. On whatever day a person meditates on you — ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: no lack is left to him, and he has to bear no sorrow at all. The dispassion of one who knows your greatness stays steady. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Whoever takes a rosary of rudrākṣa and chants the mantra with faith, and, putting aside sloth, sings your praises — Mother, bring him happiness. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Brahmacāriṇī is your name; fulfil all my works. This devotee is the worshipper of your feet; keep my honour, Mother. ॥5॥
